samples.title: Build & Deliver: Plan a Toy Route
samples.description: Build, test, and improve a route before making one final pretend delivery.
samples.goal: Plan and improve a route while solving simple problems about space and movement.

guestPreview.imageAlt: Wooden blocks arranged as roads for small toy cars.
guestPreview.safetyNote: Keep the route on the floor and away from doorways or stairs.

missions.title: Gather the route pieces
setupSteps: Place two cushions on the floor.
Add a few blocks and one spoon or toy car.
missions.sayThis: A delivery is waiting. What kind of road should we build?
missions.childChallenge: Choose where the delivery route begins and ends.
missions.tidyUp: Keep unused blocks in their basket.

missions.title: Build bridges and bends
setupSteps: Use blocks to mark two bends.
Make one cushion into a gentle bridge.
missions.sayThis: Can the driver find a way over the bridge?
missions.childChallenge: Test the route, then change one part to make it easier or trickier.
missions.tidyUp: Move any loose pieces away from walking paths.

missions.title: Make the final delivery
setupSteps: Choose a small soft item as the parcel.
Put it at the starting point.
missions.sayThis: Who needs this special delivery today?
missions.childChallenge: Carry the parcel along the whole route and invent who receives it.
missions.tidyUp: Return cushions and blocks together when the delivery is complete.

samples.title: Kitchen Shadow Safari: Explore Light & Stories
samples.description: Change the size and shape of shadows, discover creatures, and tell their story.
samples.goal: Explore how light and distance change shadows, then turn those observations into a story.

guestPreview.imageAlt: Warm torchlight casting playful shadows from kitchen tools.
guestPreview.safetyNote: An adult holds the torch. Do not shine it toward anyone's eyes.

missions.title: Find a shadow den
setupSteps: Dim one room slightly.
Point the torch at a clear wall from arm's length.
missions.sayThis: Our wall is a quiet jungle. Who might be hiding here?
missions.childChallenge: Move closer and farther from the wall to change the shadow size.
missions.tidyUp: Keep the floor clear while the room is dim.

missions.title: Discover three creatures
setupSteps: Hold a slotted spoon or colander between the torch and wall.
missions.sayThis: What animal does this shadow remind you of?
missions.childChallenge: Name three shadow creatures and show how each one moves.
missions.tidyUp: Place each kitchen tool on a nearby table after using it.

missions.title: Tell the safari story
setupSteps: Choose the child's favourite shadow creature.
missions.sayThis: Where is our creature going before bedtime?
missions.childChallenge: Tell a beginning, middle, and ending for the creature's adventure.
missions.tidyUp: Turn on the room light before returning the torch and tools.

samples.title: Rainbow Route Challenge: Listen, Remember & Move
samples.description: Follow short colour directions, remember the route, and become the leader who guides a grown-up.
samples.goal: Help your child follow two- and three-step directions, remember a sequence, and plan one for you.

guestPreview.imageAlt: Colourful paper stepping stones arranged as an indoor movement trail.
guestPreview.safetyNote: Tape paper flat on a dry floor and keep the trail away from stairs and sharp furniture.

background.alt: A colourful Rainbow Trail Mission Wall

missions.title: Learn the colour route
setupSteps: Lay the coloured sheets in a gentle curve.
Tape each corner flat.
missions.sayThis: Let's name the colours in order as we walk the route together.
missions.childChallenge: Choose the colour order, walk it once, and say each colour aloud.
missions.tidyUp: Press down any paper edge that starts to lift.

missions.title: Listen and remember
setupSteps: Stand beside the route where every colour is easy to see.
missions.sayThis: Listen first: blue, yellow. Can you visit those colours in that order?
missions.childChallenge: Follow two two-colour directions, then try one three-colour direction without a reminder.
missions.tidyUp: Pause and retape any sheet that starts to move.

missions.title: Become the route leader
setupSteps: Let the child stand where they can see the whole route.
missions.sayThis: Now you are the leader. Which three colours should I visit, and in what order?
missions.childChallenge: Create a three-step colour direction, say it clearly, and check whether the grown-up follows it.
missions.tidyUp: Peel up the tape slowly and stack the paper for another day.

samples.title: Pillow Animal Rescue: Move, Care & Pretend
samples.description: Build a safe route, rescue toy animals with care, and prepare their cosy home.
samples.goal: Move carefully through a simple route while creating a caring rescue story.

guestPreview.imageAlt: Soft cushions making a rescue route for small toy animals.
guestPreview.safetyNote: Keep cushions flat on the floor and use only soft, lightweight toys.

background.alt: A cosy animal rescue Mission Wall

missions.title: Make a safe rescue path
setupSteps: Place three cushions in a short line.
Put the basket at the far end.
missions.sayThis: Our animals need a safe path home. Where should it go?
missions.childChallenge: Arrange the cushions and test the path with one careful walk.
missions.tidyUp: Move any hard toys away from the path.

missions.title: Rescue each animal
setupSteps: Place one toy animal beside the first cushion and one beside the last.
missions.sayThis: What does each animal need on the journey?
missions.childChallenge: Carry each animal across while copying the way it moves.
missions.tidyUp: Return each rescued animal to the basket.

missions.title: Prepare the cosy home
setupSteps: Use one cushion beside the basket as a soft roof.
missions.sayThis: How will the animals know they are safely home?
missions.childChallenge: Make a welcome sound and tell a short ending to the rescue story.
missions.tidyUp: Put the animals away and return the cushions together.

samples.title: Kitchen Rhythm Parade: Copy & Create Beats
samples.description: Listen to a simple beat, copy its pattern, and create one for a home parade.
samples.goal: Listen, remember, and create simple rhythm patterns while moving together.

guestPreview.imageAlt: A wooden spoon, bowl, and scarf ready for a gentle kitchen rhythm parade.
guestPreview.safetyNote: Use a plastic bowl, tap gently, and keep the parade route clear.

missions.title: Find a gentle beat
setupSteps: Turn the plastic bowl upside down.
Hold the wooden spoon loosely.
missions.sayThis: Can we make a quiet beat that sounds like walking feet?
missions.childChallenge: Tap four slow beats, pause, then repeat them.
missions.tidyUp: Keep the spoon resting beside the bowl between turns.

missions.title: Copy the rhythm
setupSteps: Choose a two-beat pattern together.
missions.sayThis: I will tap a pattern. Can you echo it back?
missions.childChallenge: Copy two patterns, then invent one for the grown-up to copy.
missions.tidyUp: Use soft taps so the bowl stays in place.

missions.title: Lead the tiny parade
setupSteps: Hold the scarf as a parade flag.
Choose a short clear route.
missions.sayThis: Where should our music parade travel?
missions.childChallenge: March the route while humming the beat, then finish with a quiet bow.
missions.tidyUp: Return the bowl and spoon, then fold the scarf.

samples.title: Nature Detective Lab: Find Patterns & Explain Why
samples.description: Look for evidence, test two ways of grouping the same objects, and challenge a grown-up with a secret rule.
samples.goal: Practise early science and maths by comparing objects in different ways and explaining the rule used.

guestPreview.imageAlt: Leaves, smooth stones, and seed pods arranged in a simple sorting tray.
guestPreview.safetyNote: A grown-up chooses clean, non-toxic items that are too large to swallow; wash hands afterward.

background.alt: A calm nature detective Mission Wall

missions.title: Collect the evidence
setupSteps: Spread the cloth on a table or floor.
Place the tray and nature finds on top.
missions.sayThis: Detectives look closely. What is one detail you can see or feel on each object?
missions.childChallenge: Inspect every object and describe at least one clue about its colour, shape, size, or texture.
missions.tidyUp: Keep every nature find on the cloth.

missions.title: Test two pattern rules
setupSteps: Put the bowls or tray sections within easy reach.
missions.sayThis: Can the same objects belong to different groups when we change the rule?
missions.childChallenge: Group the objects by one rule, explain it, then mix them up and choose a completely different rule.
missions.tidyUp: Return mixed items to the middle before starting the next sort.

missions.title: Create a secret rule
setupSteps: Ask the grown-up to look away while the child makes two groups.
missions.sayThis: Make a secret sorting rule. I will study your evidence and try to guess it.
missions.childChallenge: Sort the objects using a secret rule, listen to the grown-up's guess, then explain the evidence that proves the answer.
missions.tidyUp: Return outdoor items responsibly and wash hands together.
